research.thesis_topic: Leveraging large language models for early detection of depression and anxiety through social media text analysis

publications.title: Mental Health Signal Detection in Reddit Posts Using BERT Fine-tuning

projects.name: SuicideWatch-NLP
projects.description: Fine-tuned RoBERTa on r/SuicideWatch posts to classify severity of mental distress. Achieved 0.87 F1. Used SHAP for explainability.

projects.name: Multimodal Emotion Recognition
projects.description: Combined text + audio features using a cross-attention transformer to detect emotional states in therapy session transcripts.

intro_call_notes: Priya is very focused on mental health NLP. She specifically wants a supervisor who works on affective computing or clinical NLP with LLMs. She is open to interdisciplinary labs that collaborate with psychology or psychiatry departments. She is NOT interested in pure linguistics or computational social science without a health angle. She prefers smaller lab sizes where she can work closely with the supervisor. She is keen on Canadian universities due to potential PR pathway. UK is also fine. She has already read papers by Stevie Chancellor (UMD), Tim Althoff (UW), and Glen Coppersmith. She found Coppersmith's work the most exciting. She is realistic about funding — needs a fully funded position with TA or RA. She does NOT want to take on debt. Timeline: apply this cycle (deadline Dec 2024 - Jan 2025).
